title: NFRA_OPLGTW OG-ap-19: the eight G3 portal tools, the five G6 news tools, their TWO read grants and the gateway release (all three halves signed at ee23dd004c on ask sha256 cdefc9a139a4)
author: 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~Z

legs.target: the deploy source is the signed release: C:/tmp/og-rel-g36 HEAD = ee23dd004c985c46d479908db46d2ad9b4f3b1c8, parent = live deployed_commit 047f11aa99, worktree clean, and no other gateway RELEASE in flight
legs.proof_required: both hashes read at the act plus the artifact's git-ref metadata as a second instrument; the one other open oplgtw sentinel named and shown to be a runner ledger rather than a release

legs.target: the G6 grant applied ALONE through safe-apply: aws_iam_role_policy.gw_news_read on opal-gateway-role, dynamodb Query/GetItem on three tables and one index
legs.proof_required: safe-apply output plus get-role-policy read back from IAM BEFORE the second policy is touched

legs.target: the G3 grant applied ALONE through safe-apply: aws_iam_role_policy.portal_tiered_read on gateway-global-internal-reader-role, s3:GetObject on json-tiered/market-overview/* only
legs.proof_required: safe-apply output plus get-role-policy read back from IAM, with the pre-existing gateway-global-internal-reader-policy proven untouched

legs.target: safe-ec2-deploy lands the 16-file release and the service comes back
legs.proof_required: the deploy output plus GET /health on 127.0.0.1:8080

legs.target: the RUNNING path carries the release bytes, including app/typed_scope.py and the three NEWS_* .env key NAMES
legs.proof_required: SSM md5 over app/, deploy/, dashboard/ and lib/ equal to the release, plus the three NEWS_* key names present where they were absent before

legs.target: all thirteen tools serve an Opal principal and refuse a non-Opal one with zero reads, the registry moves 56 -> 69 on ONE named instrument, and a numeric trading_days_behind_t1 appears where a tool states freshness
legs.proof_required: W/G36_SERVED.json with per-tool opal_served / non_opal_refused / reads_on_refusal, the registry delta on one instrument, and the CVO's condition: the thirteen read through mcp.opalinvest.dev against the 60 s ALB, a failing tool pulled alone
